debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA 50/200 bullish alignment and Ichimoku cloud structure provide structural upside framework, with extreme market fear (30/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity near support at 65.06.
debate.key_bear_argument: Confluence of bearish short-term technicals (three black crows, price below EMA 9/21/SMA 21, MACD negative histogram, no volume confirmation), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no smart money accumulation), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 311, rising dollar), and zero triggered entry strategies create overwhelming risk that outweighs contrarian sentiment.
